description: Prompt Battle is a fast-paced AI-powered development and prompt-engineering competition where participants receive a problem statement and build a functional solution using Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools. During the challenge, organizers may introduce a surprise hurdle such as a new requirement, feature, or constraint. Participants will be evaluated on their prompt engineering, creativity, problem-solving ability, effective use of AI, and final solution quality . The competition concludes with a live showcase and judge Q&A. Partcipation certificate will be provided to all the participants. REGISTRATION & TEAM SIZE Participation is allowed individually or in teams of 2–4 members . Each participant can be part of only one team . Registration Fee: ₹400 per team. Spot Registration Available! Participants can also register at the venue on the day of the event. ️ ALLOWED TECHNOLOGIES Participants are free to use publicly available AI models, AI coding assistants, frameworks, programming languages, and development platforms. Examples include ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Grok, Cursor, Kiro, Antigravity , and similar tools. Participants must arrange their own laptops, accessories, AI subscriptions, credits, and API access . raw.details:
Prompt Battle is a fast-paced AI-powered development and prompt-engineering competition where participants receive a problem statement and build a functional solution using Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools. During the challenge, organizers may introduce a surprise hurdle such as a new requirement, feature, or constraint.

Participants will be evaluated on their prompt engineering, creativity, problem-solving ability, effective use of AI, and final solution quality. The competition concludes with a live showcase and judge Q&A.

Partcipation certificate will be provided to all the participants.

REGISTRATION & TEAM SIZE

  • Participation is allowed individually or in teams of 2–4 members.
  • Each participant can be part of only one team.
  • Registration Fee: ₹400 per team.
  • Spot Registration Available! Participants can also register at the venue on the day of the event.

️ ALLOWED TECHNOLOGIES

Participants are free to use publicly available AI models, AI coding assistants, frameworks, programming languages, and development platforms.

Examples include ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Grok, Cursor, Kiro, Antigravity, and similar tools.

Participants must arrange their own laptops, accessories, AI subscriptions, credits, and API access.

COMPETITION FORMAT

The competition follows a continuous build-and-showcase format:

Problem Statement → Build → Surprise Hurdle → Final Submission → Live Showcase → Judge Q&A

The detailed competition rules, submission requirements, Agent Log requirements, evaluation criteria, and disqualification conditions are provided in the official Rulebook.

EVENT DETAILS

  • Date: 13 November 2026
  • Time: 10:00 AM
  • Venue: CSE Central Lab Ground Floor Main Block , Sahyadri College of Engineering & Management (SCEM), Mangaluru

Total Prizes worth ₹15,000

RULEBOOK

Participants are required to read the official Prompt Battle Rulebook carefully before registering. The rulebook contains the complete rules, judging criteria, competition guidelines, and code of conduct.

Rulebook-View official rulebook

CONTACT

Tharun Rai & Naren SJ
+91 6360829990 & +91 82968 33381
